text: I plan ahead before making important decisions.
I often act on impulse without thinking through the consequences.
I prefer safer options even if the reward is smaller.
I consistently stick to a budget or spending plan.
I am honest even when it would be easy to bend the rules.
I stay calm and focused under pressure.
I expect things to work out in the end.
I pay close attention to details in forms and instructions.
I can wait for a better outcome rather than taking the quick option.
I adapt quickly when plans change.
